title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As a Senior Software Engineer, You'll be responsible for designing, building, delivering and maintaining software applications & services. You will be responsible for software lifecycle including activities such as requirement analysis, documentation/procedures and implementation.
  
  
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Identify the scope of work, develop realistic effort estimates, and justify assumptions using data and facts.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and the key inputs, outputs, and deliverables across each phase.
* Leverage AI-powered development tools and coding assistants to improve engineering productivity, code quality, test generation, debugging efficiency, and documentation.
* Participate in technical discussions, contribute to architecture and design decisions, and effectively communicate technical concepts through design reviews and whiteboarding sessions.
* Drive the adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and establishment of best practices.
* Maintain high code quality through coding standards, peer reviews, unit testing, automation, and continuous integration practices.
* Seek and provide constructive feedback on software design, architecture, and implementation.
* Make informed technology decisions based on technical due diligence, risk assessment, scalability, and business impact.
* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the product, its modules, and the broader ecosystem of interconnected devices and systems.
* Design scalable, maintainable, and secure software solutions while championing quality through effective testing strategies.
* Write high-quality, standards-compliant code that delivers required functionality using the technologies selected for the project.
* Lead design reviews, define interfaces between software components, and effectively apply existing technologies to solve complex engineering problems.
* Assess application performance and drive optimization through architectural improvements, AI-driven insights, and software engineering best practices.
* Provide technical leadership in defining, developing, and evolving software solutions in a fast-paced Agile environment using modern development technologies and infrastructure.
* Demonstrate expertise in data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns, with the ability to implement efficient solutions using the appropriate programming language.
* Collaborate with Product Line Leaders (PLLs), Program Managers, and other stakeholders to understand product vision, roadmap, and business priorities.
* Identify opportunities to incorporate AI-driven capabilities into products, workflows, and engineering processes to enhance customer value, operational efficiency, and innovation.

Critically evaluate AI-generated outputs, ensuring accuracy, security, compliance, and adherence to engineering and regulatory standards before adoption in production systems.
  
  
**Education Qualification**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with a minimum of 6 years’ experience in software development.
* Hands-on experience in software development related to Core Java with knowledge of data structures, multithreading, concurrency, design patterns, SOA
* Expertise in Linux programming concepts and HL7 knowledge
* Knowledge on JVM performance tuning and memory management.
* Strong knowledge of Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, Software Design Patterns
* Experience in building sophisticated and highly automated infrastructures. Exposure to BDD/ TDD practices.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum software development framework
* Strong Debugging and Troubleshooting Expertise.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and capable of articulating specific technical topics or assignments
* Expert in breaking down problems and estimate time for development tasks
* Proven track record maintaining legacy codebases under backward-compatibility constraints

**Desired (Good To Have) Skills**

* Experience with micro-services development, Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), experience with Jenkins, GIT
* Working experience on HL7 implementation
* Good knowledge or experience in containerization platforms like Docker & Kubernetes
* Web Services, hibernate, Spring framework.

**Leadership**

* Demonstrates clarity of thinking to work through limited information and vague problem definitions
* Proactively identifies and removes project obstacles or barriers on behalf of the team
* Shares knowledge, power, and credit, establishing trust, credibility, and goodwill

**Personal Attributes**

* Able to work under minimal supervision
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to interface with senior leadership with confidence and clarity
* Able to work well with global teams, including time-zone flexibility

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

description:

Rooted in iPaaS and fueled by an ambitious vision, we integrate critical business processes to deliver the experiences and insights needed by enterprises of all sizes to accelerate their digital journey and future proof their business. Simply put, we power people to perform their best.

Jitterbit empowers business transformation by automating critical business processes for faster, more informed decision-making. Jitterbit is the only provider to seamlessly combine and simplify the power of integration, APIM, and no-code app creation to amplify the value of your tech stack and speed up your digital journey. Organizations worldwide rely on Jitterbit’s experience and expertise to help them save time and money, while creating exceptional experiences, now and into the future.

**Job Description**

Jitterbit is seeking Senior backend engineers to join our AI team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration as a Service), LCAP, and API Management platform which has been recognized in Gartner MQ for seven straight years. Our customers utilize our Low-code iPaaS, APIM, LCAP, and B2B platform to address mission-critical business automation challenges. What is our challenge? To make it easy to automate our customers’ systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust.

As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations.

You're an engineer with a knack for turning ideas into highly reliable and scalable designs. Your coding skills make your work easy for other engineers to understand, modify, and enhance. * Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers
* Data-driven decision-making skills
* Embracing a best-idea-wins approach, regardless of the source
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
* Staying current with emerging trends and technologies in AI and cloud computing

**We are looking for:**

* 10+ years of experience in building large-scale cloud-based distributed applications
* Strong experience in building multi-tenant SaaS applications
* Expertise with AI technologies, including LLM models, RAG, LangChain, and LlamaIndex
* Ability to design and develop scalable and robust AI-driven applications
* Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills with great attention to detail
* Experience with microservices and cloud-based architectures/design patterns

**Technical Skills:**

* Extensive experience in Python and Java

* Hands on Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and data warehousing solutions

**Join us to be part of an innovative team and make a significant impact on our AI-driven future!**

* Agentic Orchestration: Lead the transition from simple chatbots to Agentic AI, focusing on multi-agent collaboration and autonomous "Agent-to-Agent" communication.
* Integration Engineering: Build and maintain secure, scalable integrations using REST APIs across disparate cloud environments.

**Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer – Residential Gateways (prplOS & Wireless)Role**
**Overview**
We are looking for a Lead Embedded Firmware Developer with 12+ years of experience to drive the architectural direction, optimization, and scaling of our next-generation Residential Gateway products. Our software architecture leverages prplOS, making our platform inherently SoC-independent across diverse silicon, including Broadcom and MaxLinear SoCs.
  
  
In this role, you will serve as the technical authority for our embedded firmware and wireless stack. You will own the Linux wireless architecture, scaling our platform to support cutting-edge Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 capabilities, while ensuring carrier-grade stability through deep system-level profiling and optimization using tools like perf and Valgrind. Additionally, you will champion automation by using Python scripting to build robust testing and unit testing framework methodologies that ensure code quality across the entire lifecyle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Architecture: Lead the architectural design of resilient, hardware-agnostic gateway firmware, mentoring engineering teams and establishing embedded development best practices.
* Test Automation & Scripting: Architect and implement automated testing and unit testing frameworks using Python to validate system components, APIs, and overall firmware reliability.
* Performance Profiling & Optimization: Use perf, Valgrind (Memcheck, Massif, Helgrind), and kernel utilities to profile OS memory and CPU management, eliminate memory leaks, resolve race conditions, and minimize CPU bottlenecks.
* Wireless Stack & Driver Integration: Design, configure, and optimize Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 features using hostapd, wpa\\_supplicant, and iw sub-systems.
* Firmware Development: Architect, develop, and maintain high-performance firmware in C and C++ across various gateway hardware platforms.
* SoC Abstraction: Leverage prpl APIs to maintain hardware-agnostic implementations across multiple carrier-grade SoCs.
* Inter-process Communication (IPC): Develop and maintain scalable services utilizing ubus and/or iMTP to ensure reliable internal bus communication.
* Network Stack Management: Design and troubleshoot robust Layer 2 and Layer 3 network stacks to ensure optimal routing, bridging, and packet forwarding.
* Service Management & Provisioning: Implement and maintain device management and service models, including TR-181 data models and USP (User Services Platform / TR-369).
* Containerization & Lifecycle Management: Configure and manage containerized microservices and virtual execution environments using Docker and prpl LCM (Lifecycle Management).
* Version Control: Manage source code, branching strategies, and firmware release pipelines using Git.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* Experience: 10+ years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience in the telecom, networking, or residential gateway industries.
* Languages: High proficiency in C and modern C++ programming within resource-constrained embedded systems.
* Platform Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Embedded Linux development within OpenWrt or prplOS ecosystems.
* Device Management: Deep, production-level expertise with broadband management standards, explicitly TR-181 data models and USP (TR-369).
* Containerization: Demonstrated experience deploying, isolating, and configuring containerized microservices using Docker and lifecycle tools like prpl LCM.
* Advanced Linux Wireless: Deep knowledge of the Linux Wireless stack, including hostapd, wpa\\_supplicant, iw, and Linux wireless drivers.
* Networking Protocols: Deep understanding of Layer 2/3 networking and core routing/bridging concepts.
* Profiling & Debugging: Hands-on experience with Linux profiling and debugging tools, specifically perf and Valgrind.
* Version Control: Strong expertise managing source code and branching strategies via Git.

**Good-to-Have Requirements**

* Next-Gen Wi-Fi: Experience implementing, configuring, or debugging next-generation wireless features like Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7.
* Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python for creating automated test scripts, hardware validation, or test execution.
* Testing Frameworks: Experience building or maintaining unit testing frameworks (e.g., CUnit, Unity, PyTest) in an embedded context.
* IPC Frameworks: Deep familiarity with OpenWrt ubus and message bus architectures like iMTP.
* Hardware Abstraction: Hands-on experience developing abstraction layers on Broadcom or MaxLinear residential gateway SoCs.

**Think you have what it takes?**
This role spans four Microsoft platform disciplines — SharePoint development, Power Apps, Power BI, and Azure DevOps. The ideal candidate is a versatile M365 engineer who can build production-grade intranet solutions, automate business workflows, deliver self-service analytics, and maintain the DevOps pipelines that keep it all running reliably.
  
  
**Requirements**
**How You'll Contribute:**
**SharePoint Online Development**

* Design, build, and maintain SharePoint Online sites, portals, and intranet experiences that serve KR's internal teams — including department hubs, document libraries, approval workflows, and knowledge bases
* Develop custom SharePoint solutions using SPFx (SharePoint Framework) web parts, extensions, and application customizers — delivering rich, branded experiences that conform to the KR design system
* Configure and manage SharePoint site architecture: site collections, hub sites, managed metadata, content types, taxonomy, permissions hierarchies, and information architecture
* Build SharePoint-integrated workflows and forms using Power Automate and Power Apps — eliminating manual, email-based processes with structured, auditable digital workflows
* Implement SharePoint as the firm's primary document management and collaboration platform — migrating content from legacy systems, configuring retention policies, and applying sensitivity labels via Microsoft Purview
* Optimize SharePoint performance: page load times, search configuration, content query tuning, and CDN integration
* Conduct regular governance reviews of SharePoint environments — identifying sprawl, inactive sites, overly permissive access, and opportunities to consolidate and rationalize

**Power Apps Development**

* Design and build Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps in Power Apps to replace manual workflows, paper-based processes, and disconnected spreadsheet-driven operations across KR's service lines
* Develop responsive, mobile-friendly Power Apps that connect to SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and REST APIs — delivering cohesive user experiences across desktop and mobile
* Implement complex business logic in Power Apps using Power Fx, custom connectors, and component libraries — following reusable, maintainable development patterns
* Build and maintain Dataverse solutions for structured business data — defining tables, relationships, forms, views, business rules, and role-based security aligned to KR's data governance standards
* Integrate Power Apps with Power Automate flows, SharePoint document libraries, and Azure-hosted APIs — creating end-to-end solutions that automate and digitize business processes
* Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) coordination and post-deployment support for Power Apps — gathering feedback, resolving defects, and iterating toward adoption
* Apply ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) practices for Power Platform solutions — using Azure DevOps pipelines and solution packaging for structured, repeatable deployments across Dev, Test, and Production environments

**Power BI Development & Analytics**

* Design and build Power BI reports and dashboards that deliver actionable business intelligence to KR's leadership, advisory teams, and operational stakeholders — replacing Domo and legacy reporting tools as part of KR's BI modernization initiative
* Develop semantic models (datasets) in Power BI Desktop using DAX — building robust, reusable measures, calculated columns, and hierarchies that serve as the single source of truth for each reporting domain
* Connect Power BI to KR's data sources: Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, SQL databases, SharePoint lists, and REST APIs — using DirectQuery, Import, and Composite models appropriately
* Build and maintain Power BI dataflows for reusable, governed data transformation logic — applying Power Query (M) to cleanse, reshape, and standardize data before it reaches report layers
* Implement Row-Level Security (RLS) and Object-Level Security (OLS) in Power BI — ensuring reports enforce data access rules that align with KR's client confidentiality and internal access control requirements
* Publish and manage Power BI content in workspaces — configuring refresh schedules, gateway connections, deployment pipelines, and sensitivity labels for published reports
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements, validate data accuracy, and iterate on dashboard design — translating business questions into well-structured, intuitive visuals
* Document all semantic models, data source connections, and report logic — maintaining a living data dictionary that supports governance, audit, and onboarding of new developers

**Azure DevOps Engineering**
